_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV: KPIs vital homebuilder (Volume > ASP > Backlog), puis Margin (cycle pressure), puis Revenue.

kpis.signal: Volume #1 retail. Croissance solide via expansion géographique (Sun Belt, Texas, Florida).
kpis.description_fr: Nb logements livrés. Croissance via expansion Sun Belt + Texas + Florida. Cible 80k+.
kpis.description_en: Number of homes delivered. Growth via Sun Belt + Texas + Florida expansion. 80k+ target.

kpis.signal: Prix moyen en baisse 2024 sous l'effet mix (entry-level dominant). Volume>prix strategie.
kpis.description_fr: Prix de vente moyen homes livrés. Stratégie LEN: volume > prix. Mix entry-level croissant.
kpis.description_en: Average sales price for homes delivered. LEN strategy: volume > price. Growing entry-level mix.

kpis.signal: Backlog en baisse. Cycle accélération livraisons. Strategy LEN = livrer rapidement, pas stocker.
kpis.description_fr: Backlog homes pas encore livrés. LEN privilégie vitesse livraison vs stocking. Healthy ~16-20k.
kpis.description_en: Homes in backlog not yet delivered. LEN prioritizes delivery speed vs stocking. Healthy ~16-20k.

kpis.signal: Marge brute en pression: stratégie volume + incentives pour absorber taux hypothécaires hauts.
kpis.description_fr: Marge brute homebuilding. Pression 2023-2024: incentives (mortgage rate buydowns, price cuts).
kpis.description_en: Homebuilding gross margin. 2023-2024 pressure: incentives (mortgage rate buydowns, price cuts).

kpis.signal: CA total. Volume +10% partiellement compensé par ASP -7% = croissance ~4%.
kpis.description_fr: CA consolidé. Volume croissant compense baisse ASP. Croissance sustained ~4-5%.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated revenue. Growing volume offsets ASP decline. Sustained growth ~4-5%.

_notes: Lennar Corp. Fiscal year ends end November. FY24 = year ended Nov 30, 2024.
